# Finish Line Home Repair

> Realtor-focused home repair and inspection punch-list services in Lafayette and West Lafayette, Indiana. One trusted contractor for the common repairs that keep real estate closings on track.

## About
Finish Line Home Repair provides professional, dependable home repair services with a focus on real estate transactions and inspection repair punch lists. Over 20 years of maintenance and repair experience. Locally owned and fully insured.

## Service Area
Lafayette, West Lafayette, Dayton, Rossville, Brookston, Battle Ground, and surrounding Indiana communities.

## Services
- Inspection repair punch lists
- Drywall repair and paint touch-ups
- Minor electrical repairs (outlets, switches, fixtures, GFCI, smoke detectors)
- Minor plumbing repairs (faucets, drains, shutoffs, toilets, disposals)
- Trim and finish carpentry
- Doors and hardware
- Window repairs
- Deck and exterior repairs
- Gutters and downspouts
- General handyman services

## For Realtors
A reliable single point of contact for inspection-related repairs and punch lists — fast turnaround, simplified coordination, professional communication, and smoother closings.
